Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role for EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read from Parameter Store

Resources:
  EC2CloudWatchParameterStoreRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: EC2CloudWatchParameterStoreRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2CloudWatchParameterStorePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: arn:aws:ssm:*:*:parameter/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: EC2CloudWatchParameterStoreInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2CloudWatchParameterStoreRole

Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role
    Value: !GetAtt EC2CloudWatchParameterStoreRole.Arn
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile
    Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
